query:
SELECT state_code, district, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, 
       candidate1_vote_pct, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, candidate2_vote_pct,
       called_winner, called_party, updated_at
FROM house_races 
WHERE state_code IN ('WV', 'NE')
ORDER BY state_code, district;

SELECT state_code, status, candidate1_name, candidate1_party,
       candidate1_vote_pct, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, candidate2_vote_pct,
       called_winner, called_party, updated_at
FROM senate_races
WHERE state_code IN ('WV', 'NE');
